requirement.original: 早餐午餐移除默认之后就无法添加新的了
requirement.clarified: After dragging a default breakfast or lunch board card to the sidebar (deselect), the slot's skipped flag in editorTripData is never cleared. isGated stays true, keeping data-droppable=false permanently. The user cannot drag any new candidate back into that slot.
requirement.what: Clear edSlot.skipped = false in handleSidebarDrop and applyBridge so gated pre-arrival meal slots become re-droppable after deselect
requirement.why: Day 1 breakfast/lunch are seeded server-side with skipped: true (pre-arrival placeholders). The client never clears that flag after the user removes the default card, permanently blocking re-adds.

included: handleSidebarDrop setEditorTripData updater — add skipped = false after slot is guaranteed to exist
applyBridge — add unconditional setEditorTripData call to clear skipped on MEAL_SLOTS target slot
excluded: Cafe, activity, entertainment isGated logic (no skipped pre-seeding for those slot types)

success_criteria: After board-to-sidebar drag on a skipped meal slot, editorTripData.days[N].slots[slotId].skipped is false
isGated evaluates to false on next render; data-droppable becomes 'true'
applyBridge clears skipped on any MEAL_SLOTS target regardless of originSlotId value
late_arrival_placeholder is not mutated by either fix
Dinner slot drag-and-drop behavior is unchanged (no regression)
constraints: MEAL_SLOTS constant (line 2227) is the correct scope guard for the applyBridge fix

root_cause_analysis.symptom: After dragging default breakfast/lunch board card to sidebar, the slot stays permanently gated (data-droppable=false). All subsequent drag attempts are rejected via _flashReject.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Day 1 breakfast/lunch are seeded with skipped: true by the server. handleSidebarDrop's setEditorTripData updater populates options[] but never writes skipped = false. applyBridge's setEditorTripData is only invoked when originSlotId is non-null and differs from targetSlotId — this guard excludes the sidebar-to-board path where originSlotId is null.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — not a regression; pre-arrival skipped flag was always present but the deselect+re-add flow was not previously supported
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The skipped flag was added to handle pre-arrival placeholder display. No clearing code was added because the add-back flow was not originally in scope.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: isGated (line 913) checks edSlot.skipped unconditionally. Once skipped is true it stays true, so the slot can never accept a drop even after the user explicitly removes the default item.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since Day 1 pre-arrival handling was introduced; surfaced only when user attempted to add back after removing
observations: handleSidebarDrop setEditorTripData updater at lines 2359-2402 confirmed by Read tool: no assignment to .skipped anywhere in the updater body (inferred)

applyBridge at lines 2949-2979 confirmed by Read tool: setEditorTripData block is under guard 'if (originSlotId && originSlotId !== targetSlotId ...)' at line 2956; sidebar-originating drops pass null as originSlotId so the block is skipped (inferred)

isGated at line 913 confirmed by Read tool: 'edSlot.skipped || edSlot.late_arrival_placeholder' — no other path clears skipped in the codebase (grep result: only lines 3213, 3280 read skipped, neither writes it) (inferred)
root_cause_analysis.diagnosis_completeness: incomplete (inferred only — browser runtime not measured)
root_cause_analysis.localization_evidence: Source-reading confirmed: handleSidebarDrop synthesis block (lines 2355-2402) and applyBridge (lines 2949-2979) are the only two write paths for editorTripData meal slot state. Neither writes skipped = false.

git_bisect_result.bisect_blocked: not a regression bug; skipped flag always present; git bisect not applicable

development_approach.strategy: Two targeted insertions in scripts/lib/react_template.tpl.
